patch_description: Replace the random point placement with a proper optimization: initialize from an icosahedron (12 vertices) plus 2 extra points, then run a local optimization on the scale-invariant objective dmin/dmax using a smoothed min/max over pairwise distances (annealed temperature) with L-BFGS. Finally renormalize (translate centroid to origin, scale so dmax = 1). This should push the squared ratio near the reference 1/4.165849767.
